observations: The hollow brass tank and tall iron bail produce a readable lantern silhouette.
The visible warm flame and brass tank survive the gameplay-distance view.
The second version connects the glass dish and rain-cap bearing supports.
Glass is very subtle in beauty lighting; its form is much clearer in clay.
Thin frame edges show aliasing or faceting; the flame is stylized and lacks rich combustion detail.
Surface wear is restrained and lacks authored storytelling detail.
No claim of AAA quality or independent art acceptance is made.
